title: QurbaniHat
description: QurbaniHat is a modern online marketplace for buying and selling sacrificial animals with ease and trust.It connects buyers and sellers, ensuring a smooth, transparent, and convenient Qurbani shopping experience.

title: Dragon News
description: Dragon News is a modern news platform that delivers fast, reliable, and up-to-date news from around the world.It provides a clean user experience with categorized content for easy browsing of latest headlines and stories.

title: KeenKeeper
description: KeenKeeper transforms how you track relationships. Moving away from cluttered social media, it provides a clean, Vercel-inspired interface to log interactions, view analytics, and maintain a timeline of your social life. This project is a testament to modern software engineering, focusing on performance, clean code, and a premium user experience.

title: RecipeHub
description: RecipeHub is a full-stack recipe sharing platform where users can discover, create, save, and manage recipes. It provides a clean, responsive interface with secure authentication and personalized dashboards, making it easy for cooking enthusiasts to share their favorite recipes and explore dishes from others.

title: DocAppoint
description: Built a full-stack MERN-based doctor appointment booking platform with secure JWT authentication and protected routes. Developed doctor listing, doctor details, appointment booking, and search functionality for seamless user experience. Implemented user dashboard features allowing authenticated users to manage, update, and cancel appointments. Designed a fully responsive interface optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
